title: fix(metadata-protocol)!: a package commit's plan and revert address the committing package's own row; a deleted row's restore asks the package-less close

_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ86dqPUQ7umCq81TqWVdRR92)_
Fixes #29414

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none needed — `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` already says the package-less save, reset and rollback of a movable row are refused once movable (D11), and places every customization of an installed base in its paired `.custom`; nothing it says becomes false.

> **Freeze:** the #27737 freeze (6594835694) lifted when #29788 merged as 339f63da; main 0e4b0fa4 was merged at 7a6e6cd4, clean, with the protocol.ts hunks at their symbols. The later §3b freeze (6599581744) was lifted at 6599690891 before any §3b work began. Head f74094ff merges main at c5ddbea9, clean.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：包提交的撤销计划（`publish-drafts` 记录的 `existedBefore`/`prevVersion`）只读发布包自己的那一行；按提交撤销（`POST /packages/:id/commits/:commitId/revert`，整包回滚经它）的删除与恢复两支都只针对提交所属包自己的行。恢复绑定恒为提交所属包：该包的行已删时 `restoreVersion` 按所述包重建，本门永不写无包行；只读基础包自身的提交由 #29390 的具名基础关闭拒掉。恢复写入基础包的 `.custom` 配对行时，经 `restoreWriteFor`（与逐项回滚共用的同一推导）由覆盖写入闸判定；未声明覆盖的版本逐项拒绝（`NOT_OVERRIDABLE`），不写任何东西。
- 为什么改：实测 main 上，基础包旧行旁边的 `.custom` 配对包首次发布，被记成"编辑了基础行的版本 10"；撤销这次提交时去找基础行，被 #29390 的关闭拒掉，配对包的覆盖仍在服务、撤销答 `success:false`。另一路：基础行删除后撤销其编辑提交，会插入一条无包行（#28576 关闭的那种写入）。
- 风险与回滚：只改提交门的寻址与恢复写入判定；删除行后撤销从"静默写无包行"变为按提交所属包重建或逐项拒绝（收窄，故 `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`）。回滚即撤销本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` 的 `revertCommit`（`commitPackageId`、`restoreWriteFor`）、`publishPackageDrafts` 计划读、`sys-metadata-repository.ts` 的 `restoreVersion` 新增 `packageId`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol exec vitest run src/protocol.named-base-overlay-write.test.ts`，预期 28 个全过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **The plan names the publishing package's row.** `publishPackageDrafts` reads each item's pre-publish active row with `package_id: request.packageId`. Every draft it promotes is listed under that package and promoted into that package's row, so another package's row of the name is not the item's pre-publish state.
- **Both revert limbs name the committing package's row.** `revertCommit` reads `commitPackageId` off the commit row and states it on the soft-remove limb's read and delete, and on the restore limb's read and `restoreVersion`. A pair creation commit beside a row bound to its read-only base now removes the pair's row, and the base row is served again.
- **The restore binding is always the committing package.** `SysMetadataRepository.restoreVersion` takes `packageId` (a local extension, as on `delete`). When stated, it writes that package's row, and creates it again when it is gone. When omitted, behaviour is unchanged. This door therefore never writes a package-less row. A read-only base's own commit whose row is gone is refused by the #29390 named-base close.
- **M1: a restore into the base's paired `.custom` row is judged by the override write gate** through `restoreWriteFor`, the derivation the per-item rollback now shares. A version declaring no override (a legacy plan naming the base row's version) is refused per item with `NOT_OVERRIDABLE`, and nothing is written.
- **Spec entry text.** The `packageless-overlay-write-closed` entry names the two commit doors (`POST /api/v1/packages/:id/commits/:commitId/revert` and `POST /api/v1/packages/:id/rollback`). It is a text change only, with no new id or key, per claim amendment 6596154325.
- **Fixtures.** Seven suites seeded a package's commit over package-less rows, or served a commit row with no `package_id`, a shape no publish produces. Each now binds its rows to the commit's package, with no assertion changed. The publish audit harness arms its rival write on the second package-scoped read of the name. The objectql `protocol-publish-package-drafts.test.ts` capture-read pins (:159, :209) gain `package_id: 'app.edu'`, the plan read's new scope (52e25699).

## Tests

- Red first through the real door (`packages/qa/dogfood/test/package-commit-revert-path-package.dogfood.test.ts`, booted showcase, `origin/main` 7dae3b3c): the pair-beside-base case failed on the plan (`items: [{ existedBefore: true, prevVersion: 10 }]`), and the deleted-row case failed (`success: true`, the package-less row written).
- Unit (`src/protocol.named-base-overlay-write.test.ts`) 28/28. The new legacy-pair-commit case is refused `NOT_OVERRIDABLE`, and the pair row stays declared and served. Two new gone-row controls restore into the pair's row and into the writable package's row. The deleted-base-row case asserts the named-base rollback sentence. Those 4 fail with `protocol.ts` and `sys-metadata-repository.ts` restored from 55837b78 (4 failed, 24 passed) and pass with the rework.
- Dogfood `package-commit-revert-path-package` 12/12.

## Acceptance notes

- **`rollbackMetaItem` shares the addressing defect (measured, not fixed here; filed as #29848).** The per-item rollback beside a base-bound row and the pair's override answers `403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE` naming the base row.
- **`commitPackageId` is an unchecked read** (`const commitPackageId: string = row.package_id` on an `any` row whose column is `required: false`). No producer or door reaches a package-less commit row: the one writer always stamps it, and both REST doors refuse a row whose package is not the path's. Only an in-process `revertCommit({ commitId })` on a hand-made row could pass `null`. Recorded by the contract review as should-fix S1 and accepted at this landing.
